title: orbitopt GEO-raising mission config v1.0
description: A user-editable YAML/JSON config for the GTO->GEO orbit-raising mission (orbitopt.viz.geo_raising.build_from_config), letting a user tune orbit elements, spacecraft parameters, and the optimizer/propagation/verification knobs without touching source. Unlike scene-1.0.json (which deliberately allows unknown 'foreign member' fields for forward compatibility), this schema is deliberately strict (additionalProperties: false everywhere) -- catching a typo'd field name here, before any compute runs, is the entire point of `orbitopt validate`. Every section besides `mission` and `output` is optional; an omitted section (or omitted leaf field within a present section) falls back to orbitopt's own built-in defaults -- the same values the 'goes' built-in mission already uses -- so the minimal valid config just re-derives that mission exactly.

schemaVersion.description: Which version of this mission-config schema the document was written against.

id.description: Stable slug for the produced scene, e.g. 'goes-gto-geo'.

launch_profile.description: The real Atlas V 541 / GOES-16 launch-to-GTO profile this mission starts its trail from (already in orbit, not at the pad). Defaults to the real GOES-16 numbers if omitted.

apogee_dwell_minutes.description: How long the trail dwells at apogee before the first LAE burn (illustrative pacing, not a physical constraint).

spacecraft.description: Defaults to a GOES-16-like spacecraft if omitted.

penalty_weight.description: Optimizer penalty weight for missing the finite-burn-feasible delta-v cap.

campaign_search.description: How the optimizer searches for the minimum feasible number of apogee-raising burns.

min.description: GeoRaisingProblem requires n_burns >= 2 (n_burns == 1 is fully determined, not a search).

propagation.description: See viz.geo_raising.compute_and_export_geo_mission's docstring for the step_size_s precision-vs-runtime tradeoff (60s->~575km terminal drift, 2s->~24km).

verification.description: The high-fidelity (tudatpy, J2+J22+Sun/Moon) re-fly + final-burn targeter (orbitopt.verify.geo_insertion.verify_geo_raising) that checks the optimizer's schedule actually reaches true GEO. Runs by default; `orbitopt run --skip-verify` (or enabled: false here) skips it for faster iteration.

epoch_mjd2000.description: Real mission epoch (first-apogee/injection date) as MJD2000. Defaults to 2026-08-01 if omitted.

scene_file.description: Where `orbitopt run` writes the produced scene-1.0.json document; overridable with --out.
